title: Dualizing complex and Verdier dual
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]
and the coefficient
conventions [def-trf-coefficient-conventions], $A=A_{E,n}$, put $s=\Spec k$, and let $Y$ be a
separated [def-weil-proper-morphism] finite-type
[def-weil-finite-type-morphism] $k$-scheme whose
structure morphism
$a_Y:Y\to s$ is
exceptionally admissible in the sense of [def-trf-admissibility] (which
holds for every such $Y$; no ambient datum is assumed). Put

$$
\omega_{Y,A}:=Ra_Y^!A_s,\qquad
D_YM:=R\mathcal Hom_A\bigl(M,\omega_{Y,A}\bigr)
\qquad
\bigl(M\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,A)\bigr),
$$

using the constructible exceptional inverse
image of $a_Y$ [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image] and the
derived internal Hom and tensor
[def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Here $A_s$ is the constant
coefficient sheaf, $D(Y,A)=D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ is the ambient
derived category on the small pro-etale site of $Y$
[def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and $D^b_{ctf}(Y,A)$ is the
finite-Tor subcategory [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude] of the
bounded constructible derived category
[def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility]. Regard $D_Y$ here as the
contravariant functor from $D^b_{ctf}(Y,A)$ to $D(Y,A)$; on a morphism
$u:M\to N$ it acts by $R\mathcal Hom_A(u,\operatorname{id}_{\omega_{Y,A}})$. The *evaluation* is the canonical map

$$
\operatorname{ev}_M:D_YM\otimes_A^LM\longrightarrow\omega_{Y,A}
$$

obtained from the tensor–internal-Hom adjunction
(the natural currying isomorphism of
[lem-weil-pbc-ringed-internal-hom-exact-restriction], followed by
the derived-Hom identification of [lem-pur-rhom-global-sections]): it is the transpose of
the identity of $D_YM$ under the
adjunction isomorphism

$$
\Hom_{D(Y,A)}
\bigl(D_YM\otimes_A^LM,\omega_{Y,A}\bigr)
\cong
\Hom_{D(Y,A)}
\bigl(D_YM,R\mathcal Hom_A(M,\omega_{Y,A})\bigr).
$$

Here $\omega_{Y,A}$ is the *dualizing complex* of $Y$ over $A$
and $D_Y$ the *Verdier dual* functor.
